enGuide: After this point the game is pretty linear and it isn’t possible to get stuck.

simpleJp: 【異世界】一本道をひたすら進む
jpGuide1: ※以後はルート分岐が無い1本道なのでそのまま進める
jpGuide2: 分岐など無い一本道になりますので 攻略していません
enGuide: Just pick every choice until they start to repeat saying the same thing and move to other others when they do.
